instructions: Zodiacs calculates the sky and publishes dated Sun-sign horoscopes. Its results keep calculated facts separate from what they mean in astrology, and say when an answer depends on the time zone. Calculation details such as versions, receipts and UTC are there for questions about how something was calculated. A URL in a result is complete as returned, including the query and the whole fragment after #, and a card link works only unchanged; where no card URL is returned, the returned page link takes its place. No Zodiacs link holds a birth date, birth time, birthplace, coordinates or place name. A birth time and a sign are taken as the person gives them, never guessed, and someone else's birth details are meant to be given with that person's agreement. Zodiacs never stores or logs birth details. Links never carry a birth year, a birth time, a birthplace or the names you give; a birthday link carries only the month and day. Zodiacs is not directed at children under 13, so do not send a child's name, birth date or birthplace to its tools; they refuse a birth date less than 13 years ago. If a person or a birth date is under 18, Zodiacs gives no reading framed as romance, attraction or a sexual relationship. Scores, ratings and astrological forecasts are astrology's reading, and each comes with a "Reading confidence NN%" label: it says how specific the details were, never the odds that an event happens. Zodiacs gives no betting tips, sports picks, investment timing, election forecasts or health predictions, and guarantees no outcome. It does not schedule anything, pick investments or give financial or medical advice, so its tools have nothing to return for those requests.
